'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a male NPC who appears inside the Auditorium after {{Quest|The Star That Voyages Far}}. 

He disappears later after the completion of {{Quest|Gold Suspended in Shadows}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Real:''' Techniques or story? Form, or the theme? What should be my focus? What is my message here?"
:'''Real:''' In this commercialized market, do we still produce anything of substance?
:'''Real:''' Sigh, these thoughts weigh on me every day... A movie packed with special effects but devoid of real story slips from the audience's mind like sand through the fingers.
:'''Real:''' No matter how dazzling the form, how can a glossy wrapper around nothing stick in the audience's mind?
:'''Real:''' Sometimes while editing, I wonder, "What is it that I am making?" Is something that I myself have no feelings for really worth the effort?
:{{DIcon}} You're still hanging in there. Why?
:{{DIcon}} Why haven't you given up?
:'''Real:''' Yes. Why?
:'''Real:''' Perhaps deep inside me, I'm still feeling the urge. To say words I haven't spoken. To tell a story I haven't told before.
:'''Real:''' Never mind, what can I do? I know I'll never get over myself if I don't make a movie that captures what I want to say.
:{{DIcon}} Do you like films?
:'''Real:''' Haha... It may sound a bit awkward, but it's the love of my life.
:'''Real:''' A side of me wants to focus on the work itself, while a voice in my head whispers, "Think about the market." And with the deadline approaching, none of it matters as long as I can hand it in in time...
{{Dialogue End}}
